question: What contemplative visualization grants the power to shake the triple world?
premises: A smoke-colored object or hue is to be contemplated.
The contemplation is to be done always.
The result is shaking the triple world.
inference: By always contemplating the smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
uncertainties: The object that is smoke-colored is not explicitly named in this verse.
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating what is smoke-colored, one can shake the triple world.
